evidence: All 694 model_data*.json / points_info.json members read by HTTP Range from the official ZIP; size and CRC verified per member. Task point requests extracted from the pinned RoboTwin revision 13c3c47 envs/*.py (50 tasks, 172 requests).
method: For every task actor created from assets/objects with its sampled model ids, each fixed contact/functional index request (and each all-contact grasp) was compared with the annotation counts of every sampled variant. Built-in create_box/create_sphere actors carry synthetic annotations and were excluded.
conclusion: Only 086_woodenblock (no contact annotations) and 021_cup variants 6-7 (two contacts, left arm asks for index 2) mismatch; both are classified as expert_failed by src/robotwin_phys/planning.py. No other task requests a contact or functional index that its sampled official variants lack.
